summary_en: TOMONY Holdings increased its interim dividend by 0.50 yen to 15.50 yen per share and raised the projected full-year dividend by 0.50 yen to 31.00 yen per share for fiscal 2025, marking six consecutive years of dividend increases. The projected payout ratio is 32.5%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Interim Dividend of Retained Earnings and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2025
translation_en_brief:
TOMONY Holdings announced on November 13, 2024, that it has decided to pay an interim dividend of 15.50 yen per share (up 0.50 yen from the previous forecast) with an ex-dividend date of September 30, 2024, and effective payment date of December 8, 2024. The company also revised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2025, increasing the final dividend from 15.00 yen to 15.50 yen per share.

As a result, the full-year dividend is projected at 31.00 yen per share, compared to 26.00 yen in the prior fiscal year. This represents the sixth consecutive year of dividend increases. The projected payout ratio is 32.5% for fiscal 2025, compared to 31.0% in fiscal 2024.

The company attributed the increase to strong performance in the interim period and anticipated net profit for the full year exceeding initial projections. The company stated this increase is consistent with its medium-term shareholder return policy for the sixth management plan period (fiscal 2024-2026), which targets a dividend payout ratio of 35% or higher and a total return ratio (dividends plus share buybacks) of 40% or higher by fiscal 2026. Combined with announced share buybacks, the total return ratio for fiscal 2024 is projected at approximately 38.5%.
